error[ZBX-E0202]: can't run the command in the rootfs
  while  starting container web-1
  cause  a dynamically linked program also needs its loader and libc inside the
         rootfs; a missing loader is reported as a missing file
  cause  '/bin/nothere' is missing from the rootfs
  cmd    /bin/nothere
  name   web-1
  rootfs /srv/alpine
  step   exec (61 of 63)
  fix    look in the rootfs:               ls -l "/srv/alpine/bin"
         or use the program's full path:   zbx run --rootfs /srv/alpine -- /bin/sh
  more   zbx explain E0202
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0202.html
